summary.text: Bobby Charles is the Republican nominee for governor. A lawyer who grew up in Wayne, Maine, he served as Assistant Secretary of State for International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs from 2003 to 2005 and later founded a consulting firm in Washington, D.C.

paragraphs.text: Earned a B.A. from Dartmouth College (1982), an M.A. from Oxford (1984) and a J.D. from Columbia Law School (1987).
Served as U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs, 2003–2005; founded The Charles Group, a consulting firm based in Washington, D.C.

sources.title: GOP candidate Charles vows to dismantle DHHS during Lewiston town hall
